title: RFC 9421 Signature Decoder & Web Bot Auth Readiness
description: Decodes and validates RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures (Signature-Input / Signature), lints a Web Bot Auth JWKS directory (Ed25519), and scores Web Bot Auth readiness. This is the signature substrate Visa Trusted Agent Protocol builds on. Reference rules are static and may age — verify against RFC 9421 and the Web Bot Auth draft. Does not perform cryptographic signature verification.

mcp_tool_definition.name: decode_http_message_signature
mcp_tool_definition.description: Decode and validate an RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signature, lint a Web Bot Auth JWKS, and score Web Bot Auth readiness. Use when a developer is implementing agent identity via HTTP Message Signatures (Web Bot Auth or Visa Trusted Agent Protocol).
